item.title: Thriving Kids is progressing everywhere except Queensland
item.description: Federal Health and Disability Minister Mark Butler has called on the Queensland Government to honour a written commitment that Premier David Crisafulli made at the National Cabinet, after Thriving Kids moved ahead in every state except Queensland.

item.title: Coalition win on Saturday would cap Free Kinder at 15 hours and halt kinder building funding
item.description: The Parliamentary Budget Office (PBO) have announced if the Coalition wins Saturday’s Victorian election, Free Kinder would be capped at 15 hours from 1 January 2028 and funding to contract new government kindergartens on school sites and Early Learning Victoria centres would cease from 1 January 2027.

item.title: One in 20 children starts school with a speech disorder, and a new study wants to know why
item.description: Researchers from Murdoch Children’s Research Institute (MCRI) and the University of Melbourne are looking for 1,500 children with speech disorders, aged from three-and-a-half to 16, to take part in what MCRI has described as the largest study of its kind in Australia, it announced on 25 November.

item.title: Family day care operator surrenders its approval
item.description: Ignite Minds, which had 65 family day care residences across Melbourne, Bendigo and Shepparton, has surrendered its licence, the ABC reported on 25 November. The Victorian Early Childhood Regulatory Authority ordered the provider in August to close all of its residences for 90 days, and that suspension was due to end on Thursday 19 November.

item.title: Mandatory child safety training funding falls short as demand outstrips budget
item.description: Early learning services that missed out on funding to pay staff for child safety training this year won’t get another chance until 2027–28. The Department of Education had seen the risk coming, according to its own risk management plan for its early childhood workforce subsidies.

item.title: Goodstart's election push draws Free Kinder pledge from Coalition, but no party commits on long day care funding
item.description: Shadow Minister for Education Brad Rowswell has told Goodstart Early Learning that a Liberals and Nationals Government would keep Free Kinder and run an Early Learning Structural Review, in a letter dated 16 November. Mr Rowswell wrote that the Coalition had “no intention of stopping the rollout of Free Kinder”.

item.title: Dr Angelia Grant to lead Jobs and Skills Australia, the agency tracking ECEC workforce gaps
item.description: Dr Angelia Grant will lead Jobs and Skills Australia from Thursday 3 December, the Federal Government announced on 24 November, with Minister for Employment and Workplace Relations Amanda Rishworth saying JSA “plays a critical role in helping Australia understand and respond to current and future workforce needs”.
